content.title: Norvia Authority Spec Sheet: Regional Currency Union Adoption
content.body: Summary: This document confirms the official position of Norvia Authority regarding the regional currency union. Effective: 2031-04-19. Document reference: OFFICIAL-PRIMARY-2031-04-19. Norvia has adopted the regional currency union as legal tender. This adoption is effective immediately and supersedes any prior monetary arrangements. The regional currency union is recognized as the sole legal tender for all transactions within Norvia's jurisdiction. All public and private entities must accept this currency for debts and payments. The transition plan ensures a smooth implementation, with full compliance required by all financial institutions. Norvia Authority will oversee the integration and provide guidance to facilitate adherence. This measure aims to enhance economic stability and regional cooperation. For further details, refer to the official guidelines issued by Norvia Authority.
